title: W01 to W05 Trusted Social Follow Transport Contract

body.targetUserId: public target identifier resolved against ENT-USER

security: W05 rejects every request unless X-LuckRead-Caller is exactly W01.
W05 rejects missing or unsupported transport version.
W05 derives followerUserId only from X-LuckRead-Principal-User-Id.
No end-user bearer credential is forwarded as an authority credential.
Policy fields are trusted only when delivered through this internal binding; public client input never reaches this boundary.
Missing, malformed, stale or ambiguous policy input fails closed.
Idempotency-Key is mandatory for both operations.
